manifest: TouchlineSimulator Visual V1 — PixelLab asset freeze
retrieval_method: non-generative HTTP GET of existing PixelLab assets (frame CDN + authenticated /mcp tileset endpoints); zero PixelLab generations spent
notes: Original downloads live under originals/ and must never be resampled, recolored, antialiased, or otherwise altered.
Any runtime-packed representation must be derived into a separate directory, leaving originals/ byte-identical to HASHES.sha256.
Animated Idle intentionally does not exist for the MVP; static 8-direction rotations are the accepted Idle.
The experimental east-only Dribble/Carry animation (group 5fc20f4b-b01e-4443-88ed-7a5b5f187681) was intentionally NOT imported.

Animation frame canvases are larger than the 128x128 character base (motion padding, source-faithful): 140x140 for most directions, 144x144 for north-east/north-west in the v3 template groups. Frames are assumed pivot-centred per PixelLab convention; this must be validated visually in the renderer sandbox.
Signed/transient URLs and credentials are deliberately excluded; assets are addressed by PixelLab IDs only.

idle.source: static 8-direction rotations of character 31a11357-1d06-40c3-958e-5103d1fdd8cd (no animation group; rotations are part of the Idle state)

jog.acceptance: VERIFIED_ACCEPTED (user directive: template Jogging group is the base; custom South-East group fills SE)

preserved_variants_not_runtime.acceptance: EXPERIMENTAL/PRESERVED — competing SW jog variant, superseded at runtime by template Jogging SW per user directive
EXPERIMENTAL/PRESERVED — competing E jog variant, superseded at runtime by template Jogging E per user directive
EXPERIMENTAL/PRESERVED — competing W jog variant, superseded at runtime by template Jogging W per user directive

upper.description_short: professional pitch grass with mowing variation

grass_tileset.slicing_rule: Slice the sheet using each tile's bounding_box from tileset_metadata.json ONLY. Never derive positions from wang_N names or original_position (produces banding, per PixelLab metadata warning).
grass_tileset.scope_limitation: Surface texture/material ONLY. This tileset does NOT define pitch geometry, white markings, boundaries, penalty areas, goals, or simulator coordinates. Authoritative geometry comes from the engine.

integrity.checks: PNG signature, per-chunk CRC32, full IDAT zlib decompression, IHDR dimensions, RGBA-8 (color type 6) on all 161 PNGs; per-direction frame counts complete; zero errors

engine_boundary: Visual integration consumes authoritative engine state read-only. No simulation file (decisions, movement physics, acceleration, stamina, possession, passing, reception, shooting, tackling, restarts, coordinates, timing) may be modified for visual reasons.
